rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Read complete proofs from A001-A015 and attempt to reconstruct each code independently. Check finite success, decoding, duplicate witnesses, normalizers, and the final expectation.

deliverables.description: JOINT_CODE_GAPS.json: exact failed lines and their effect on the theorem

acceptance_criteria: Review complete original sources from the relevant A001–A015 chain, not only authors' summaries.
Reconstruct finite success, decoding, distinct-run multiplicity, global codebook, normalizers, and the expectation paid by influence.
Any representation-existence or universal residual statement used without proof remains an explicit gap; send one precise repair target to A089.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One reviewable code/representation theorem receives a full proof-chain verdict; the queue cap prevents collecting unread candidates.

assignments.target_statement: Audit A021-A030 and A061-A065 with exact physical children. Test conditional probabilities, averaging order, boundary costs, and reuse of influence.

deliverables.description: RESTRICTION_GAPS.json: boundary, averaging, and credit-reuse issues

acceptance_criteria: Audit the actual A021–A030 and A061–A065 proof chain with exact physical children and the same fair-tree filtration.
Preserve μ and its KL rebate, distinguish it from block mixing M_W, and check zero-mismatch as well as rare-branch endpoints.
Verify path probabilities, terminal entropy, and nonreuse of influence/credit; a valid local identity alone does not settle the stopping theorem.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One complete restriction candidate is accepted at its proved scope or returned with the first precise unpaid line.

assignments.target_statement: Audit A031-A040 and A066-A070 for a genuine use of Boolean phase constraints. Test each stated theorem on the strongest applicable non-Boolean relaxation as a scope diagnostic.

deliverables.description: BOOLEANITY_ANALYTIC_REVIEW.md: signed, conditional, and normalization audit
BOOLEANITY_GAPS.json: exact failed hypothesis or unpaid term

acceptance_criteria: Reconstruct the A031–A040 and A066–A070 chain from full sources and actual Boolean inputs.
Check all signs and full-Booleanity uses against the fixed-prefix controls, and retain conditional auxiliary entropy.
Enforce T=H(v/Z)−log₂Z and distinguish raw-L failure, normalized lower payment, and sufficient recovery; verify every needed implication independently.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One full Booleanity/KL/analytic candidate receives a complete-chain review with honest domain and first-gap reporting.

assignments.target_statement: Take a specific failed proof step from the first three referees and prove the strongest correct replacement that preserves a useful application. Keep the original failed statement and counterexample visible.

deliverables.description: REPAIRED_LEMMA.tex: strongest useful corrected statement and proof
REPAIR_HISTORY.md: original failure, changed hypothesis, and retained application

acceptance_criteria: Choose one concrete failed line and preserve its original statement and counterexample beside the repair.
Prove the changed statement and explicitly recompute its implication for the intended application.
As a mathematical contributor to the repair, recuse from approving it; route the revised complete chain to an uninvolved referee.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete replacement lemma preserving one useful application, or a proved barrier showing why that application cannot survive.

assignments.target_statement: Reprove a near-complete campaign candidate from its theorem statements and original sources, without relying on the supplied derivation. Report the first unreconstructed implication precisely.

deliverables.description: BLIND_RECONSTRUCTION.tex: proof developed from statements and original inputs
RECONSTRUCTION_COMPARISON.md: first unreconstructed implication and final scope

acceptance_criteria: Start from theorem statements and original baseline sources; do not copy the candidate's supplied derivation into the purported independent proof.
Record the critical reconstruction before comparing it with the authors' proof and identify genuinely shared unproved assumptions.
A near-complete universal candidate requires all dimensions, limit passages, terminal cases, and constant independence, not agreement on a summary.

advisory_upstream.interface: exact statement graph and original sources

assignments.renewal_milestone: One full candidate is independently reconstructed or its first irreparable/open implication is precisely identified.
